gloss: to hire; to take on; to employ

definitions.gloss: to hire; to take on; to employ
definitions.explanation: To formally bring someone on as a worker or staff member. More deliberate and formal than plain {雇|やと}う, often used of a company taking on new personnel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れる。
examples.english: We will take on a new employee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れた。
examples.english: The company took on young talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れることにした。
examples.english: We decided to take on several part-timers in preparation for the busy season.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{雇|やと}う→雇う：02320_yatou⟧ (to employ) + ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to take in). The ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ element stresses bringing the person into the organization, so it suits formal hiring of staff.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れる: to take on an employee
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れる: to bring on talent
- ⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雇|やと}い{入|い}れる: to newly hire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雇|やと}う→雇う：02320_yatou⟧: to employ; to hire — the plain, everyday verb; {雇|やと}い{入|い}れる sounds more formal and organizational
